newsitem.title: USA: SNET launches digital wireless service.
newsitem.headline: SNET launches digital wireless service.

text.p: Southern New England Telecommunications Corp said Monday it was launching digital cellular phone service in Connecticut.
The service will be offered in Connecticut's bigger cities first, the company said in a statement.
Digital technology allows better sound quality and other features.
SNET said the service will be available as an option in addition to its present cellular service.

Customers who want the service will purchase new "dual mode" phones that will have the advantages of cellular technology, where available, and cellular service as they drive through non-digital coverage areas.
